description: On the green cloth in front of you sits a white AirPods charging case and a white charging cable, with a white backdrop behind. The left hand reaches in from the left to pick up the case and tilt it upright while the right hand brings the cable tip in from the right; the right hand aligns and pushes the connector into the case’s charging port, making the case a left-hand object and the cable a right-hand object, then the left hand lowers the now-connected case back onto the cloth.
